title: Eye diagram and ray diagram sheet
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 21 (Eye diagram and ray diagram sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 21: How we see: light enters the eye. To understand that we see objects because light travels from them into our eyes

picture.draw: Draw and label: Eye diagram and ray diagram sheet

questions.q: Draw how you see a book by a lamp.
questions.a: Arrow from lamp to book, then from book to eye
questions.model: Start at the source: the lamp. Ruler arrow to the book. Then reflect: arrow from the book into the eye.

questions.q: Which part of the eye focuses light?
Why does the pupil get smaller in bright light?
questions.a: To let in less light and protect the retina

questions.q: Label the eye diagram (pupil, iris, lens, retina, optic nerve) and draw a ray diagram for seeing a tree in sunlight.
questions.a: Correct labels; arrows Sun to tree to eye
questions.model: Teacher labels the pupil first: 'The pupil is a hole that lets light in.'

questions.q: Why can't we see in total darkness?
questions.a: No light reflects off objects into our eyes

questions.q: Why do cats see better than us in dim light?
questions.a: Their pupils open very wide and a reflective layer behind the retina reuses light.

questions.q: Big question: can you see white paper in a completely dark room?
questions.a: No: no light reflects off it into your eyes.
